hamming_linkage.partition_note: draw_labels_full_posterior.npy: all draws in one cluster. draw_labels_sampling_precision.npy: fcluster at sampling_precision_tau (finest τ where A/B chain mixing tests pass at every cluster; see tau_balance_scan.json).

sample_ab_legend.sample_A: draws from first ⌊K/2⌋ MCMC chains (merged order)

sampling_precision_balance.mixing_test: Per τ: for each cluster with n >= min_cluster_size, two-sided binomial H0: P(draw in sample A | cluster) = p0, p0 = global fraction in A (first ⌊K/2⌋ chains); Bonferroni alpha across clusters tested at that τ.
sampling_precision_balance.scan_order: tau decreasing (coarse to fine); stop at first τ with a mixing-test failure
